name: Sunken Temple: Jammal'an never hexes a lone player
contract: Jammal'an the Prophet 5710 is the Sunken Temple (map 109, expansion 0) encounter boss (instance_encounters 488).
His SmartAI (pending rev_20261004_90 event 3) casts Hex of Jammal'an 12479 at a random hostile player within 30
yd (target type 5, which can pick the top-threat player), first after 12 s of combat and then every 40 s; the
hex's removal transforms and charms that player (instance_sunken_temple.cpp, 12480 and 12483). Hex follows the
vanilla dungeon boss control rule (BossControlTargeting.h): it never takes a tank or healer specialization, and
it needs a second player engaged with Jammal'an, so a lone player is never hexed. Jammal'an removes his unit
flags 5 s out of combat, so the fight starts after that. A single damage dealer fights alone, so Hex of Jammal'an
is never cast. The players are level 54 humans, matching the boss, so its spells land at their normal hit chance.
They group in Stormwind and teleport into one instance, where the boss is summoned at its own stats; player
health fixtures keep everyone alive through the window. Hex fires at 12 s and then every 40 s. When Jammal'an's
own Earthgrab Totem (8376, root 8377 every 15 s) has the target rooted at that moment, SmartAI skips the cast and
its retry is overwritten by the 40 s repeat (SmartScript::ProcessTimedAction recalculates the timer after the
action), so the window covers the second Hex. A control requires the boss to keep casting Flamestrike 12468
through the same window, so the 'never cast' result cannot come from an idle or broken AI.

steps.label: Let the characters finish logging in
CONTROL: dps is inside the dungeon
Summon the boss in the group's instance
Let the boss's spawn events settle
Run through the first Hex window and the 40 s repeat
CONTROL: Jammal'an is still fighting the player
CONTROL: the boss's AI keeps casting (Flamestrike 12468)
Jammal'an never casts Hex of Jammal'an at a lone player
The lone player is never hexed
